verdict.rationale: The README documents installing a single named skill with `npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills --skill wiki-yylo`. It also offers an interactive `skills` CLI install, and the skills are described as independently versioned, so developers can pick individual skills rather than the bundled plugin or the install-all path. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of selecting an arbitrary subset of several skills (interactive picking is only implied), an equivalent selective option in the native `yy skills install` path (which updates all agent copies), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
